title: Death Stranding Isolations Anime Reveals Teaser Trailer, More Staff
content: Kojima Productions revealed on Friday a teaser video, visual, and more staff members for the Death Stranding Isolations anime series based in the universe of Hideo Kojima 's Death Stranding game.
author: ANN

title: 'Death Stranding: Isolations' Reveals Additional Staff, Teaser Promo
content: The official X of Kojima Productions revealed additional staff, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video for the Death Stranding: Isolations anime series on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere worldwide on the Disney+ streaming service in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Fire Force
content: Based on Atsushi Ookubo’s action Shonen manga, Fire Force remains one of the most beloved action fantasy series of all time. While the manga was released in 2019, the series took four years to release an anime adaptation by David Production.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Kicks Off English Dub for Fall 2026’s Darkest Romance
content: The English dub of Firefly Wedding is finally streaming on Crunchyroll, although there has been a delay. It’s one of the biggest anime series of the Fall 2026 lineup, and also the darkest romance fans have been introduced to in a while.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach Creator Returns With Closer Look at New Characters Revealed in Anime Finale
content: More than 22 years after the anime debut, Bleach has finally reached its conclusion with the fourth part of the Thousand-Year Blood War Arc. As one of the most iconic Shonen Jump series of all time, the series took longer than expected to adapt the entire manga, but the wait was more than worth it.
author: ComicBook

title: Solo Leveling’s New Story Brings Back Jinwoo’s Most Tragic Ally
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Solo Leveling webtoon! While the upcoming Solo Leveling movie has yet to share information on its release window, the action role-playing game continues to drop brand new content for fans.
author: ComicBook

title: Rin Suzukawa's Outsider Paradise Manga Switches Publishers to Kadokawa, Gets Full Color Continuation
content: Rin Suzukawa announced on her X/Twitter account on Wednesday that her Outsider Paradise has switched publishers from Futabasha to Kadokawa . The manga moved from Futabasha 's Manga Action magazine to Kadokawa 's KadoComi website.
author: ANN

title: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters Season 3 Fate Revealed, And the MonsterVerse May Not Be the Same
content: The MonsterVerse has become a popular shared universe franchise running alongside the likes of Marvel and DC. Having started back in 2014 with the Godzilla reboot film , the MonsterVerse expanded into two separate film franchises focused on Godzilla and Kong, before bringing the two iconic Kaiju (or “Titans”) together…
author: ComicBook

title: Shiretto Sugee koto Itteru Gal Manga Takes 4-5 Month Break
content: Taichi Matsuura and Otsuji 's Shiretto Sugee koto Itteru Gal ( Gals casually say incredible things. -The daily life of Paranormal High School- ) manga announced on Wednesday that the manga will go on hiatus and will return sometime in February or March next year.
